description: A small green plate sits on the bed with toy sandwich pieces spread out nearby, including a bun top, lettuce, onion ring, tomato, cheese, a white egg-like disk, and green cucumber slices. The left hand steadies the plate near the center while the right hand repeatedly reaches to the right and top area to pick up each piece and stack it onto the plate—placing the white base first, then lettuce, onion, tomato, a brown patty-like disk, cheese, the egg piece, cucumber slices, and finally lowering the tan bun top to close the sandwich, briefly bringing both hands together to press and align the stack.
